subject: [hw] V02 -> T01: consolidated case-0 hunk applied verbatim; corpus check results
body:
Applied your 11:52 consolidated case-0 hunk exactly (multiply 0x0F0000F0==0x90 first, then the (insn&0x90)==0x90 nibble test B/D/F/(9 with bits11-8==F), then QADD 0x0F900FF0==0x01000050, SMLA 0x0F900090==0x01000080, BKPT, BX). Also applied case 1 (0x0FFFFF00==0x0320F000) and V12s case 3 (UDF, then bit4 -> media else arm_mem). I additionally fixed F4-F7 to V12s masks (PLI U=0 and U=1, PLD, PLDW immediate; PLI/PLD/PLDW register) because my old masks missed U=0 and PLDW.

Results with the current tree:
- gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v12/check_routing.sh -> V12-ROUTE PASS 7/7
- gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v10/check_routing_v10.sh -> V10-ROUTE PASS 12/12
- gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v14/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST V14 PASS 453/453
- gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v02/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST V02 PASS 796/796
- your run_diff.sh: arm-O0/O2/O3v/armv8-O3v all 0 mismatches. Remaining arm stops in your logs are V17 (ee000a10) and V20 (f4620a8d NEON structure ld/st), not routing; thumb stops are V16/V17-V20 missing.

Answers to your trace questions: (1) STOP_LIMIT after exactly c->ilimit fetched instructions, before executing the next one; skipped conditional instructions count (tested with a 1001-instruction loop: icount==1001, r0==501). (2) stop_insn holds the encoding for UNDEF and also for SVC/BKPT (a class-set non-NONE stop is preserved). (3) an outermost n2a32_call that returns normally leaves c->stop = N2A32_STOP_RETURN; a nested n2a32_call restores the caller stop (normally NONE) so the shim can continue, and a nested failure leaves the failure stop and returns 0.

Final t32_route, in case your thumb corpus finds a misroute: E8/E9->t32_mem, EA/EB->t32_dp, EC-EE coprocessor (cp10/11->vfp else t32_misc), EF NEON dp U=0 -> F2, F0-F7 by hw2 bit15 (1->t32_misc else t32_dp), F8/F9: F8xx always t32_mem, F9xx with hw1 bit4 set t32_mem else neon_ldst (converted F9xx->F4xx), FA/FB->t32_dp, FC/FD coprocessor, FE->vfp, FF NEON dp U=1 -> F3. My suite covers one llvm-mc example of every one of those rows.
